headline: Continued hearings to September 3 for 34-lot Wellington Road subdivision, South Willow Street gaming facility, and 1265 South Willow Street fueling station.
summary: Several hearings were continued to September 3, 2026, including a 34-lot subdivision on Wellington Road and projects on South Willow Street. Hearings on the Orange Street and Pearl Street parking deck and on 434 Hevey Street were continued for two weeks. Hearings on 351 Chestnut Street and 25 Lowell Street were also held, and the hearing decisions will come at a later meeting.
decisions: Continued S2026-005, the Wellington Road subdivision, to September 3, 2026 (motion carried).
Continued SP2026-010 and CU2026-004, the charitable gaming facility applications, to September 3, 2026 (motion carried).
Continued S2026-011, SP2026-011, and CU2026-005, the 1265 South Willow Street fueling station applications, to September 3, 2026 (motion carried).
Determined six applications complete and set them for public hearing (motion carried).
Continued the public hearing on PDSP2024-002 for two weeks.
Granted a waiver from Section 4.8.A.2. and accepted the lot line adjustment application as complete for public hearing (motion carried).
Continued the public hearing on SP2026-014, the 434 Hevey Street conversion, to the business meeting in two weeks.
Approved the minutes of July 2, 2026, as written (motion carried, one abstention).
